snippet.title: [OUTDATED] 15 Minutes of Pixplorer Gameplay ! (Bosses, Fishing, Building & Spells)
snippet.description:
[This gameplay session isn't up to date, the game improved since]
Play the demo: (unavailable for now)
Discord: https://discord.gg/Z5V2EVCUP9 

*This demo offers a brief glimpse into the full game’s mechanics and world on a predefined seed. The complete version removes all limits on exploration, featuring dozens of additional biomes, structures, animals, and creatures to encounter.*

- Start the game, adjust your controls, and create your own world.
- You’ll move and jump in a 3D environment with a 2D top-down perspective.
- Open your inventory by pressing E and equip items with a right-click.
- Head to the underground dungeon on the left and battle enemies using your spells.
- Once you defeat the giant skeleton, loot the chest for rewards.
- On the right side of the map, face the werewolf boss. 
- After defeating both bosses, you’ll have completed the demo’s main objectives.
- Explore the map’s limited surface, featuring two distinct biomes: grasslands and a swamp.
- Try fishing or capturing insects to unlock new spells.
- Use blocks to build your own little house!


Pixplorer is a sandbox action-RPG that merges a 3D world with a 2D art style. Players can explore a procedurally generated universe, find diverse biomes, craft weapons, build houses, uncover hidden dungeons, battle monsters, and level up their characters. Whether you’re constructing a cozy home, mastering real-time combat, or hunting rare fish and insects, it's your unique adventure!

I'm super happy to present it to you! Feedback is highly appreciated in the comments :)

- Ability to build in 3D with blocks
- Very fun dynamic combats with spells, parry, dodge etc.
- 16 biomes
- 100+ weapons & 40+ spells
- 30+ monsters
- 100+ fish and insects to capture
- Increase your stats with farming and fighting
- Many structures and dungeons to find
- Hidden secrets and puzzles !
- Infinite world with real-time procedural generation

Itchio: https://whiax.itch.io/pixplorer
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3966650/Pixplorer/ 
Twitter: https://x.com/WhiaxHC 
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/whiaxhc.bsky.social
Reddit: https://reddit.com/r/pixplorer/

02:41 First Boss: Skeleton Giant
03:58 Crafting & Fishing
08:12 Second Boss: Werewolf
09:00 Unlocking Spells in the Swamp
10:53 Building a House, Garden & Crafting Furniture
